snp5.13:1.1: “The home-leaver, the craving-cutter, the unmoved one, said venerable Bhadrāvudha,
snp5.13:1.3: the enjoyment-leaver, the flood-crosser, the free one,
snp5.13:1.4: the speculation-leaver, the intelligent one - (him) I beg,
snp5.13:1.5: after hearing the Strong One, they will go away from here.
snp5.13:2.1: Various people have come from the countries,
snp5.13:2.2: and are waiting for your saying, O hero,
snp5.13:2.3: you must explain (the Teaching) properly to them,
snp5.13:2.4: for this Teaching has been understood by you.”
snp5.13:3.1: “You must remove all attachment to craving, Bhadrāvudha, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.13:3.3: above, below, and across the middle,
snp5.13:3.4: for with whatever they are attached to in the world,
snp5.13:3.5: with just that Māra follows a man.
snp5.13:4.1: Therefore knowing (this), the mindful monk should
snp5.13:4.2: not be attached to anything in the whole world,
snp5.13:4.3: seeing that with what is called attachment to clinging,
snp5.13:4.4: these people are clinging to the realm of Death.”
